subject: Only Run Certain Functions on server.R Dependent on 'input' function from ui.R

messages.author: c0ac1a2ca1463b3a
messages.subject: Only Run Certain Functions on server.R Dependent on 'input' function from ui.R
parts:
I am able to change the layout depending on the selectInput() function in ui.R using conditionalPanel().   However I would like to run only certain functions on the server.R side dependent on the result from selectInput() on the ui.R side.  Is there a way to do this?

I have a many functions on the server.R side, but I only want to run a select few dependent on the result of selectInput().  Right now all functions from server.R side run on startup, however since some functions take time to complete and are unnecessary dependent on the selectInput() result I do not wish to run these until the value from ui.R  is selected.

In another way, how can I restrict functions on the server.R side from running until it is selected on the ui.R side?

Thanks.

Abbreviated Example:

ui.R

  mainPanel(
    conditionalPanel(condition="input.Page=='One'",
      plotOutput("basicPlot",width = "800px", height = "600px")),
    conditionalPanel(condition="input.Page=='Two'",
      list(verbatimTextOutput("BootStrap"),plotOutput("basicPlot2",width = "800px", height = "600px"))),
  )


server.R

  output$basicPlot <- reactivePlot(function() {
     basicPlot(x,y)
  })


#### Only run these if "input.Page=='Two'"

  output$BootStrap <- reactivePrint(function() {
     bootstrap(x,y)
  })

  output$basicPlot2 <- reactivePlot(function() {
     basicPlot(x,y)
  })
